requirements_summary: StackForge builds an in-IDE copilot that needs repo-aware retrieval with low tail latency. Requirements: incremental embedding updates on git push, per-repo namespaces in vector DB, chunking by AST boundaries to avoid noisy context, configurable embedding model and quantization profiles, model-version pinning and deterministic fallback, EU data residency for embeddings/index, streaming token API with sub-100ms median and <200ms p99 for single-token delivery in editor, cost controls and per-repo billing tags.
po_notes: POC scope: ingest 3 top repos (~6M LOC combined), test embedding recall for 10k dev queries, measure end-to-end p50/p95/p99 from editor stub to streaming token. Evaluate Dedicated small footprint (2 x A10G equivalent) vs Private on customer infra. Need pricing for both.
